_comment: Upstream sources that must be re-checked on a schedule, because the live page changes
and our distilled copy silently goes stale.
`last_verified` is the date a human or Claude last diffed the live source against the
file and reconciled them — NOT the date the file was last edited. Bump it only after
scripts/check_freshness.py reads this and reports what is overdue. It is a pure date
comparison: no network, no API key, safe to run on every session start.

sources.title: Confluence - Ops Center Related Tickets and Permissions
sources.precedence: Wins on HOW to fill in a form - its instructions are more pointed than JSM's.
sources.notes: Covers only the most common requests by design. Fetchable via the Confluence MCP tools - no browser needed.

sources.title: JSM - CorpDev Support portal (all request types)
sources.precedence: Wins on WHICH forms exist - a form either exists or it does not.
sources.notes: Authenticated SPA: needs Claude in Chrome, not curl. Groups 3328 TCP-Development, 3333 TCP-Operations, 3329 Tyler Identity Cloud, 3332 Forge/TCW, 3330 3rd Party, 3331 internal-only. Harvest each group page for create/<id> links, then open each form and read its top-of-form help text. Watch for deprecated/superseded forms and dead links.

sources.title: JSM - CorpDev Feature Requests portal
sources.precedence: Sole authority for feature requests and enhancement ideas.
sources.notes: Separate portal from 3168. Single form group/3385/create/4367; requests are visible on a voting board for 60 days after completion. The deprecated 4137 redirects here.

upload_targets._note: TCP-KB-Identity is deliberately excluded - Hard Rule 1. A change to a shared file must be uploaded to EVERY listed collection or the copies drift.
